title: Dynamic Governance of Multi-LLM Agent Systems for Collaborative Conversational Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2608.11207v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When two LLM agents with structurally opposed objectives interact across multiple turns, the absence of a shared goal function produces not competition but collapse: the visitor capitulates, the site agent stops varying its approach, and the conversation terminates without achieving either agent's stated objective. This paper asks whether a control-theoretic governance layer can substitute for that missing goal function. The Experience Orchestrator (EO) addresses this in a simulated financial services environment where a site agent guides a visitor toward advisor contact while the visitor maintains psychologically realistic resistance. translated_title: 多LLM代理系统的动态治理机制实现协作对话结果
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11207v1 公告类型：新 摘要：当两个目标结构对立的LLM代理在多轮交互中互动时，缺乏共享目标函数会导致的不是竞争而是崩溃：访客屈服，站点代理停止调整其方法，对话终止而未能实现任一代理的既定目标。本文探讨控制理论治理层能否替代缺失的目标函数。体验编排器（EO）在模拟金融服务环境中解决了这一问题，其中站点代理引导访客联系顾问，而访客保持心理上真实的抗拒。EO通过三种机制治理联合轨迹：一个上下文老虎机（CB），选择基于真实网络分析校准的内容臂；一个PID控制器，通过动态模式约束强制行为一致性；以及一个POMDP信念跟踪器，维护访客状态的概率模型。
tldr: 本文提出一种控制理论驱动的动态治理层（体验编排器），通过上下文老虎机、PID控制器和POMDP信念跟踪器，解决多LLM代理系统中目标冲突导致的对话崩溃问题，实现协作性对话结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a control-theoretic governance layer (Experience Orchestrator) using a contextual bandit, PID controller, and POMDP belief tracker to resolve conversational collapse in multi-LLM agent systems with conflicting objectives, enabling collaborative outcomes.
